paite: Na lak ua zawlnei hiam, mangnimi ham ahongom a, chiamtehna hiam, thillamdang hiam hon etsak a,
english: If a prophet or a dreamer of dreams arises among you, and he gives you a sign or a wonder,

paite: chiamtehna hiam, thillamdang hiam hon etsak, ahong tangtun a, na theih ngei louh uh, "pathian dangte zui ni e, a-nna uh sem ni," na kiang ua achihleh;
english: and the sign or the wonder comes to pass, of which he spoke to you, saying, “Let’s go after other gods” (which you have not known) “and let’s serve them,”

paite: huai zawlnei hiam, mangneimi hiam thute na ngaikhe ding uh ahi kei. TOUPA na Pathian uh na lungtang tengteng uh leh na hinna tengteng un na it uhia, itlou chih theihtelna ding ua TOUPA na Pathian un ahon ze-et ahi.
english: you shall not listen to the words of that prophet, or to that dreamer of dreams; for Yahweh your God is testing you, to know whether you love Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh na zui ding ua, amah laudan na siam ding ua, athupiakte na zui ding ua, athugente na zui ding ua, amah nna na sem ding ua, amah na len tinten ding uh ahi,
english: You shall walk after Yahweh your God, fear him, keep his commandments, and obey his voice. You shall serve him, and cling to him.

paite: Huai zawlnei hiam, mangneimi hiam hihlup ding ahi. Aigupta gam a pan hon pikhia a, saltanna inn a pan hon tanpa TOUPA na Pathian un zuih ding thu ahon piak lampi a pan hon pialsak dia, TOUPA na Pathian uh tung a helna thu agen ziak in, huchibang in na lak ua thil hoih lou na hihmang ding uhi.
english: That prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall be put to death, because he has spoken rebellion against Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, to draw you aside out of the way which Yahweh your God commanded you to walk in. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

paite: Na unaupa, na nu tapa hiam, na tapa hiam, na tanu hiam, na zi pom lai hiam, na lawm nangmah hinna bang hial nangawn in leng, ahon zol a, kisa ni, "pathian dangte nna sem ni," ahon chihleh; nang hiam, na pipute hiam in leng na theih louh uh pathiante;
english: If your brother, the son of your mother, or your son, or your daughter, or the wife of your bosom, or your friend who is as your own soul, entices you secretly, saying, “Let’s go and serve other gods”—which you have not known, you, nor your fathers;

paite: na kimvel ua, na kiangchin ua omte hiam, na kigamlatpih deuh uhiam, kawlmong a pan kawlmong khat lam pha a mite pathiante;
english: of the gods of the peoples who are around you, near to you, or far off from you, from the one end of the earth even to the other end of the earth—

paite: pha na sakpih ding uh ahi kei, amah na ngaikhe ding uh ahi sam kei. Na hehpih ding uh ahi kei a, na hawi ding uh leng ahi sam kei, na iim ding uh leng ahi sam kei hi.
english: you shall not consent to him nor listen to him; neither shall your eye pity him, neither shall you spare, neither shall you conceal him;

paite: Na hihlup ngeingei ding uh ahi zaw. That ding in khut na kha masa ding a, huai khit chiang in mipi tengteng in akhut uh akha ding uh.
english: but you shall surely kill him. Your hand shall be first on him to put him to death, and afterwards the hands of all the people.

paite: Suang a na denlup ding uh ahi, Aigupta gam a saltanna inn a pan hon pikhepa TOUPA na Pathian ua kipan hon pialsakna ding azon ziak in.
english: You shall stone him to death with stones, because he has sought to draw you away from Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

paite: Huchi in Israel mi tengteng in aza ding ua, alau ding ua, na lak ua huchibang tatsiatna himhim achingta kei ding uhi.
english: All Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall not do any more wickedness like this among you.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un na tenna ding ua ahon piak na khua khat a na lak ua kipan Belial tate khenkhat hong pawt a,
english: If you hear about one of your cities, which Yahweh your God gives you to dwell there, that

paite: huai khopi a mite na theih ngei louh uh, "pathian dangte be ding in apimang uh," chih thu kigen na zak uleh kan unla;
english: certain wicked fellows have gone out from among you and have drawn away the inhabitants of their city, saying, “Let’s go and serve other gods,” which you have not known,

paite: dingkhia unla, phatuamngaitak in dongkhia un. Ngai un, thudik ana hih a, huchibang thilkihhuai na lak ua hih ahi, chih theihtel ahihleh,
english: then you shall inquire, investigate, and ask diligently. Behold, if it is true, and the thing certain, that such abomination was done among you,

paite: namsau a huai khua a tengte na hihlup ngeingei ding uh ahi. Asung a om tengteng, ganhonte toh namsau in na hihmangthang vek ding uh ahi.
english: you shall surely strike the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword, destroying it utterly, with all that is therein and its livestock, with the edge of the sword.

paite: Gallak thil teng kholak ah na lakhawm ding ua, khua leh gallak thil teng TOUPA na Pathian uh kiang ah halmang thillat in na hal ding ua, leivui lel ahi tawntung ding a, lam thak ahi nawn kei ding hi.
english: You shall gather all its plunder into the middle of its street, and shall burn with fire the city, with all of its plunder, to Yahweh your God. It shall be a heap forever. It shall not be built again.

paite: Gallak thil bangmah na khoih ding uh ahi kei. TOUPA'N aheh mahmahna akiheisan dia, zahngaihna ahon musak ding a, hon hehpih ding hi.
english: Nothing of the devoted thing shall cling to your hand, that Yahweh may turn from the fierceness of his anger and show you mercy, and have compassion on you and multiply you, as he has sworn to your fathers,

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh mitmuh a thil hoih hih dia tua ka hon piak thupiak tengteng na zuih peuhmah uleh nou ahon pungsak ding hi; na pi-le-pute uh kiang a ana kichiam khit bang in.
english: when you listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, to keep all his commandments which I command you today, to do that which is right in Yahweh your God’s eyes.
